Middle/right: edge macro-F1 and normalized categorical NLL on CV folds and the 19,160 student observations; classes are trip_id:canonical_directed_original_arc_id; class union includes reference-only and prediction-only roads. Per-observation normalized categorical NLL of the matching-candidate mass (floor 1e-7 on absent target mass; misses retained; vector not re-clipped). Normalize binary positive probabilities within each observation; absent target receives zero mass and finite log score uses floor1e-7. This is an emission log score, not a calibration claim. figures.caption: Student development observations split per the recorded definition: ambiguous = proxy within the disclosed ambiguity margin; candidate_miss = no candidate matches the proxy edge; strata overlap and each keeps misses in its denominator. Observation counts per stratum (ambiguous proxy: 1,330 / non ambiguous proxy: 17,830) differ across strata, so accuracy differences partly reflect difficulty, not just model quality; axes start at zero and are never rescaled to inflate gaps. The separate candidate_miss stratum (19 observations, top-1 = 0 by construction, NLL 16.12) is not charted; both charted strata keep those misses in their denominators. Strata come from the learning agent's recorded diagnostics — no metric is invented, and they are proxy-derived, not supplied ground truth. Proxy labels: nearest reference-route segment + weak GPS-motion orientation; NOT supplied pointwise ground truth.
